identitySignals: Federal motor carrier record (FMCSA SAFER) lists 'D HARRIS TOURS INC' with a Vallejo, CA mailing address, matching the agenda's 'D. Harris Tours, Inc.' in Vallejo, CA
SAFER lists the company as a passenger bus carrier (intrastate, 13 power units), matching OUSD's 'School Pupil Activity Bus (SPAB) Services Agreement' for transportation
LinkedIn company page for D Harris Tours describes a Bay Area bus company with SPAB-certified drivers serving student and school events, linking to dharristours.com
research.notes: Company website is a JavaScript-only page, so contact details could not be read from it. The phone and mailing address in the federal record may be a personal or home contact, so they were deliberately omitted. Headquarters is taken from the Vallejo mailing address; the physical address on the federal record and LinkedIn is South San Francisco. No CA Secretary of State or SAM.gov record was verified from an official page.

profile.summary: A for-profit bus company serving the San Francisco Bay Area. It provides bus transportation for student trips, school and work events, weddings and graduations. It describes its drivers as certified for School Pupil Activity Bus (SPAB) service and its buses as accessible under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

sources.title: SAFER Web - Company Snapshot D HARRIS TOURS INC

review.notes: FMCSA SAFER shows D HARRIS TOURS INC, an active intrastate passenger bus carrier with a Vallejo mailing address matching the agenda, and LinkedIn's description matches the summary (SPAB-certified drivers, ADA buses, student and school events). Headquarters 'Vallejo, CA' is only a mailing address; both SAFER's physical address and LinkedIn give South San Francisco, so that field is not supported.
